message:
Want to talk T-Netix, and about not having the option to claim your spouse as a human being base on the repugnance of a so called "inmate billing company". where the automated person seem to be collecting more ph minutes for it prompts and warnings than you get in connection time. How about this fact that my spouse is unable to contact me for weeks at a time because the charges for him to dial a (347) code cost more than 32.00 per 30 min calls. if this is not the worse how about the fact that it take up to 28 hours for the account to clear before he can attempt to try and reach me wait! no 5 consecutive days we have not spoke with a clear account status of more than $60t. what about the $9. quick collect charges applied or the $6. surcharge for a credit card use inorder to apply credit to your "T-Netix " correctional billing account. I need to know does any 1 out there have a solution.
p.s. thanx for your site it provides more vent for the out side population than our families inside the WALLS. YOU ROCK
